mine: the expectation of wealth perishes too
note: Hebrew 'onim can be "strength, wealth" (from 'on) or "iniquity" (from 'awen); the parallel with death favours the hope placed in wealth.
Hebrew loqeach nephashot means "takes lives/persons"; often used of killing, here likely "wins people over"; the KJV phrase is not about evangelism in the original setting.
